Cleomaceae.key_door: glandular 3-foliolate clammyweed + asymmetric 4-petal flower + many exserted stamens + long capsule

lineage_lesson: Brassicaceae and Cleomaceae visibly share the 4-petal Brassicales blueprint, but diverge strongly in stamen number, leaf architecture, symmetry and fruit details.
taxonomy_notes: Current Kew treats Polanisia dodecandra as a synonym of Cleome dodecandra.
Current Kew treats Polanisia dodecandra subsp. trachysperma as Cleome trachysperma at species rank.
Legacy Polanisia names remain useful for older FNA/field-guide cross-reference.
